name: Kuaishou creator center

disclosure.zh: 含 AI 生成内容时，在「作者声明」里选「内容为 AI 生成」（2025-09-01 起的标识办法要求自己声明，平台说声明不影响流量）。正文不放站外链接（导流会被处罚）。
disclosure.en: If the video has AI-generated content, choose 作者声明 → 内容为AI生成 (required by the labeling rules since 2025-09-01; Kuaishou says it does not reduce traffic). No off-site links in the text (导流 is penalised).

guide.zh: 打开「发布视频」页，应用放入视频、填好作品描述和 #话题。封面、可见范围由你定，再点「发布」。
guide.en: On the publish-video page the app adds the video and types the description with #topics. Set the cover and visibility, then press Publish yourself.

zh: 作者声明（含 AI 生成）
可见范围 / 评论 / 下载

notes: UNVERIFIED selectors (written 2026-10 without a logged-in session): check them on the live page, then set status to verified + lastVerified.
Web upload: 15 min / 4 GB (help centre). QR login on cp.kuaishou.com.
